description: Give work, or make a request of your own: a title, what done looks like, criteria. It can go to an agent (`assignee`, an agent id from list_agents: the assistant in a one-assistant workspace, which does every kind of work), to people (`member_ids`, user ids from list_members), or both. Given only to people it is theirs and no agent is woken. With neither, the lead routes it: the CEO in a team, the assistant otherwise.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

member_ids.description: people in the workspace: their user ids (list_members)
